title: 第7章 中场休息第8章 树欲静而风不止
content_zh:
“你是真不知道还是装作不知道啊！
你不知道每年魔法学院才招收多少学生吗？你知道今年一千多个同学里面有多少被魔法学院录取的吗？看着你这张脸我就想揍你一顿！
吉恩！
为什么不是我～”
凯文真是好气，三个美女也被录取了，吉恩也被录取了，搞不好以后他们长大了还会一起结婚，想想凯文都心痛～为什么有魔法天赋的不是自己？想到这不由得又看了一眼喜笑颜开的三美女～
“怎么很重要吗？我错了凯文，我道歉。”
吉恩马上配合还伸出双手举过头顶道，尼玛陪着小学生真是太麻烦了，还要装作自己也是小学生的样子，自己就表现的高冷点就呵呵受不了…不过吉恩还是想告诉凯文天狗不会有好下场的～一般天狗最后都成了接锅侠。
“呵呵，吉恩看来以后我们还得一起当同学哦！”
恩娜娇笑道，看着吉恩吃瘪她也开心。
“哦，恩娜你不是说你没办法进入冥想吗？”
吉恩对这个就奇怪了，他一问，凯文瑞隆也竖起耳朵来听。
“嘿嘿我也就是头几天无法静下心来，后面就好了啊，而且我魔法属性天赋是水木两系的，当时测试属性的时候光柱高达1.5m高，我可是甲等天赋！”
恩娜说完扬着头，活脱脱一只刚刚下完蛋后骄傲的到处炫耀的小母鸡～
“那我只有半米高呢？我的光是莹光，是什么属性？资料里没讲，也没人告诉我？”
吉恩马上问道，其实从光柱的高度来说，他的天赋可能并不强，但是他们家也不认识啥魔法师，也没有魔法师朋友资料上没有写，反正是一脸黑，只不过他还有后路，不是这个世界的人，也没有什么压迫着他前进，他就是来旅游的，最后还得回去（不过吉恩自己都没有发现最近他已经很少将这个世界与之前生活的世界做比较了，他自己都没有发现自从认识了凯文瑞隆月夜恩娜安妮几人后，越来越融入道这个世界当中去了），如果是回宇宙联合国那个宇宙还不如就就在这低力量等级宇宙，回去他也不是联合国的人～
“哈哈，吉恩你的天赋是丙等，最差的，在差就不会被录取了！
笑死我了，差一点点哦，还有光的颜色代表你是无色的，证明你是平衡属性，可以说是万能属性也可以说是无用属性，因为它没有特点～不过别灰心哈以后魔法学院有我罩着你？”
恩娜说道，笑得死去活来，因为吉恩的淡定气场，平时表现出来的也是无欲无求，所以她就喜欢看吉恩闹笑话，只要是与吉恩相关的事她最上心了，这次魔法天赋鉴定谁能知道她后来居上，竟然是三个妹纸里面天赋最强的。
“好吧，还好差点我还以为我开启了废物流主角逆袭人生呢！”
吉恩笑道，他这样其实就很欠打…毕竟都是未成年，能有多深的城府。

气的凯文在旁边哇哇大叫！
“对了吉恩那你选择的是签订协议的学习还是自由的学习？”
这时候月夜问了句，她还是一样的漂亮，问话也让人不由自主的愿意亲近她。
“我家也没有这么多钱…一个学期五百帝国金币，单单是学费！
所以我选择的是签订协议的学习方式。”
吉恩语气表现的无可奈何道。
但是表情却没有多少变化还是笑着。
“那你不是得当住校生了？”
月夜回道？要是她肯定受不了，所以她选择的是走读，而且她们几个家里都不差这些钱，都是自费读书，她们渔人族需要生活在相对湿度较高的环境里。
“没有呢，米拉想让我继续住家里，以后我得起的更早了，得赶车上下课了！”
吉恩耸耸肩道。
“那吉恩你以后就得起的很早了啊？”
瑞隆说道。
“不用啊，吉恩你可以跟我们一起上下课哦，我们三个也是走读，但是我们有专用的马车，到时候顺路来你家接你吧？”
恩娜急忙道。
content_en:
"Are you really not aware or are you pretending not to know?
Don’t you know how many students the Magic Academy enrolls every year? Do you know how many of the more than a thousand students were admitted to the Magic Academy this year? Just looking at your face makes me want to punch you!
Gene!
Why not me~"
Kevin is so angry. Three beauties have also been admitted, and Jean has also been admitted. Maybe they will get married together when they grow up. Thinking about it makes Kevin heartbroken~ Why isn't he the one with the magic talent? Thinking of this, I couldn't help but take another look at the three beauties who were smiling~
"Why is it important? I was wrong Kevin, I apologize."
Gene immediately cooperated and stretched out his hands above his head and said, "It's really troublesome to accompany an elementary school student. I have to pretend that I am also an elementary school student. I can't stand it when I act so cold and aloof... However, Gene still wants to tell Kevin that Tengu will not end well. Usually Tengu will end up taking the blame."
"Haha, Jean, it seems that we will have to be classmates together in the future!"
Enna said with a sweet smile, she was also happy to see Jean deflated.
"Oh, Enna, didn't you say you couldn't enter meditation?"
Gene was surprised by this. When he asked, Kevin Ruilon also pricked up his ears to listen.
"Hey, I just couldn't calm down for the first few days, but it will get better later. Moreover, my magic attribute talent is water and wood. When I tested the attributes, the light beam was as high as 1.5m. I have a first-class talent!"
Enna raised her head after speaking, just like a little hen that just laid an egg and proudly showed it off~
"Then I'm only half a meter tall? My light is luminous. What attribute is it? It's not mentioned in the information, and no one told me?"
Jean asked immediately. In fact, judging from the height of the light beam, his talent may not be strong, but his family does not know any magicians, and there are no magician friends who have not been mentioned in the information. Anyway, he has a dark face, but he still has a way out. He is not from this world, and there is nothing to pressure him to move forward. He is here to travel, and he has to go back in the end (but Jean himself He didn't realize that he rarely compared this world with the world he lived in before. He didn't realize that since he met Kevin Ruilon, Yue Ye, Enna, Anne and others, he has become more and more integrated into this world.
"Haha, Gene, your talent is level C, the worst. If you are poor, you won't be admitted!
It made me laugh so hard, it was almost, and the color of light means that you are colorless, which proves that you have a balanced attribute. It can be said to be a universal attribute or a useless attribute, because it has no characteristics ~ But don't be discouraged. Will I protect you from the Magic Academy in the future? "
Enna said, laughing so hard that because of Jean's calm aura and his usual lack of desire, she liked to watch Jean make jokes. As long as it was related to Jean, she cared most about it. Who would have known that she came from behind in this magic talent test and was the most talented among the three girls.
"Okay, luckily I almost thought I started a waste stream protagonist's counterattack in life!"
Jean smiled and said, he actually deserves a beating... After all, he is a minor, how deep can he go in the city.
An angry Kevin yelled next to him!
"By the way, Jean, did you choose to study under an agreement or study freely?"
At this time Yue Ye asked, she was still as beautiful, and the question made people want to get close to her involuntarily.
"My family doesn't have that much money...five hundred imperial gold coins per semester, just for tuition!
So I chose the learning method of signing an agreement. "
Jean said helplessly.
But his expression didn't change much and he was still smiling.
"Then don't you have to be a dormitory student?"
Yue Ye replied? She would definitely not be able to bear it, so she chose day school, and none of their families were short of money. They all studied at their own expense. They, the fishermen, need to live in an environment with high relative humidity.
"No, Mira wants me to continue living at home. In the future, I will have to get up earlier and have to catch the bus to and from school!"
Gene shrugged.
"Then Jean, will you get up very early in the future?"
Ruilon said.
"No, Jean, you can go to and from get out of class with us. The three of us are also day students, but we have a special carriage. Can we stop by your house to pick you up?"
Enna said hurriedly.
